title: Basic First Aid
description: Starts with what to do first, then covers checking an injured person, CPR, severe bleeding, and the 2025 choking steps (back blows plus abdominal thrusts). Also covers the recovery position, shock, low blood sugar, seizures, anaphylaxis, wound care, and kit essentials for when help is far away.
shortDescription: First steps, CPR, bleeding, 2025 choking steps, shock, seizures, anaphylaxis
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
